identifier.value: Chobe and Okavango Delta Photo Safari

product.name: Chobe and Okavango Delta Photo Safari
product.description: An 8-day photo safari combining stays at The Pangolin Chobe Hotel and a private camp in the Okavango Delta with expert photographic guidance.

identifier.value: The Best of the Chobe Photo Safari

product.name: The Best of the Chobe Photo Safari
product.description: A 7-day photo safari featuring expert guidance aboard The Pangolin Voyager and stays at The Pangolin Chobe Hotel, focused on wildlife photography in Chobe National Park.

product.name: Chobe, Delta & Kalahari Photo Safari
product.description: A 10-day photo safari covering three distinct Botswana wildlife regions: Chobe, Okavango Delta, and Kalahari, with continuous photographic guidance.

product.name: Pangolin Chobe Hotel
product.description: A 14-room hotel overlooking the Chobe River and Caprivi Floodplains, serving as a base for photo safari experiences focused on wildlife photography.

product.name: The Pangolin Voyager
product.description: A floating lodge moored on the Namibian side of the Chobe River, accommodating up to ten guests in five cabins, available for exclusive charters.

product.name: Pangolin Photo Camps
product.description: Photographic camps hosted in partnership with reputable safari operators across Southern and East Africa, timed for optimal wildlife photography.
